new_findings.title: The nextCursor fix narrows plan §3.4's response contract so that only list responses carry nextCursor
new_findings.failure_scenario: An S5 implementer builds a separate MCP or OData output schema for getObject/getInventory/getWork from the skill text, which says '응답은 data…evidenceRefs를 포함하고 목록은 nextCursor도 반환한다'. They leave nextCursor out of single-object responses. The two entry points then return different envelopes from the shared query, and the result no longer matches plan §3.4 or the existing backend envelope.
new_findings.evidence: plan:91 says '조회 응답은 data, asOf, knownAt, scope, unknowns, conflicts, evidenceRefs, nextCursor를 포함한다', for all query responses. backend ApplicationQueries.java:88 always puts nextCursor on the shared envelope, and QueryResult.java:8 has it as a field. The round-1 finding asked only to remove nextCursor from the cross-entry-point equality list, not to change the response field list.
new_findings.fix: Restore the plan wording: every query response includes nextCursor, null when there is no next page. Keep the new rule only in the equality section: cursor tokens are not compared across entry points.

new_findings.title: The PASS rule no longer states that validate.py must succeed against current inputs
new_findings.failure_scenario: Later, when coverage PASS becomes reachable, an agent cites an item with status PASS from a runtime-manifest.json assembled at an older commit. The code has changed since, and the agent does not rerun validate.py. Rule 1 and agent SKILL.md:80-81 only require 'status PASS' and describe VALID as 'just consistency', so the stale PASS looks allowed. Only rule 4's indirect 'report the mismatch' wording blocks it.
new_findings.evidence: repository-harness.md:109-113 and agent SKILL.md:80-81 ('PASS는 manifest item/profile status가 PASS인 것뿐이며 validate.py의 VALID는 일관성이다'). impl SKILL.md:75-76 says the same. validate_saved (assemble.py:738-755) is the only check that rejects a stale or hand-edited manifest. This is latent today because coverage PASS is unreachable.
new_findings.fix: Write PASS as: status PASS in runtime-manifest.json AND validate.py exit 0 on the current checkout. VALID is necessary but not sufficient.

new_findings.title: The acceptance-case schema caseId pattern is cited as enforcing the fixed 41 IDs, but it does not
new_findings.failure_scenario: An author trusts the schema citation, creates T27, and sees './verify validate' pass. They report the case as valid. It then fails only at prepare with 'Discovered case membership differs from expected cases'.
new_findings.evidence: contracts/acceptance-case.schema.json:9 has pattern '^(T[0-9]{2}|C[1-5]|V[1-8]|E[12]|HARNESS-[A-Z0-9-]+)$', which admits T00, T27-T99 and HARNESS-*. The 41-ID restriction comes only from Main.java:64 (expected set) and PreparationValidator.java:81-84,107 together with registry expectedCases 41.
new_findings.fix: Drop the schema pattern from the list of 41-ID enforcers, or note that it only bounds the ID shape. Name Main.prepare and the registry as the binding constraints.

new_findings.title: The Gherkin template still describes writing a whole new scenario.feature, while the guidance now says to add subcases to existing cases
new_findings.failure_scenario: An author follows SKILL.md:30-31 and adds a counterexample as a new subcase of V4. They copy the template as the instructions say: '…verification/cases/<ID>/scenario.feature로 둔다', including the '# language' line, the tags and '기능:'. The file either replaces the existing feature, which drops its other Scenarios and causes a subcase/Scenario mismatch, or ends up with a second Feature, which is a parse error and exit3. This fails closed, but the documented path does not work.
new_findings.evidence: Template lines 1-2 and 8-9 (feature header plus instruction to place it as the case's scenario.feature). repository-harness.md:29 says one subcase is one Scenario in the existing feature. Existing features such as V4/scenario.feature:1-3 already contain the header.
new_findings.fix: Say in the template header that, for a new subcase of an existing case, you append only the '시나리오:' block to the existing scenario.feature. The full header applies only when a case's feature does not exist yet.

new_findings.title: The interim manual V4 enumeration is routed to a 'PR description', which this fork's workflow does not have
new_findings.failure_scenario: A Step 3 or S5 worker adds a CDS projection and does the manual enumeration. Under AGENTS.md, workers return commits and checks to the coordinator, who integrates into the Task branch with no per-change PR. The 'PR 설명' therefore never exists, so the only interim evidence for the exposed surface is lost.
new_findings.evidence: repository-harness.md:152-153 says '구현 PR은 직접 열거 결과를 PR 설명에 남기고'. implementation-contracts.md:75-76 says '구현 PR은 직접 열거한 결과를 근거로 남긴다'. AGENTS.md:82-89 says workers return commit, files and checks and the coordinator alone integrates, and that main merge and PRs are done by the user (AGENTS.md:60-61).
new_findings.fix: Record the manual enumeration (command, endpoints read, writable items found, allowlist diff) in the worker's docs/execution checks file or handoff, and keep it labelled as manual or NOT_RUN evidence.

new_findings.title: The cross-owner request overstates its plan source and leaves out the coverage owner
new_findings.failure_scenario: The Step 2 owner implements the enumeration subcase with a new named catalog observation. They update only case, registry and catalog, as the request lists. assemble.py:725 hard-codes oracleCount 122 and observationCount 499, so validate_manifest can never accept a PASS after that. Separately, a reader looking for the quoted '모든 쓰기 경로 열거' with $metadata/tools/list details in plan §4.2 and D01/D08 will not find it.
new_findings.evidence: The plan has no '모든 쓰기 경로 열거'. plan:126 (§4.2) says only '실제 노출된 direct/nested/batch/projection 경로 모두 검사한다'. D01 (plan:400) is about query answers, not write paths. The $metadata/tools/list/server/discover detail comes from the skill. assemble.py:725 has 'oracleCount') != 122 or ... 'observationCount') != 499', and mandatory-oracles.json has 122 oracles.
new_findings.fix: Cite plan:126 (§4.2) and V4 (plan:444) as the source, and present the $metadata/tools/list procedure as the skill's operationalization. Add a line saying that if the subcase adds catalog oracles or observations, the coverage owner must update the assemble.py counts and test_coverage.py.
